title: Surjectivity of the prescribed scalar-extension twist map on the complete standard chart
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sfb-proj-scalar-extension-twist-chart-basic, for every positive-degree homogeneous f, the prescribed twist map on the complete standard open D₊(ψ(f)) is surjective.

proof.text: An empty target chart has only the zero section. Otherwise apply twist_fraction_descent to represent the target section by b/(ψ(f))^m. Since the denominator avoids a chart prime it is nonzero, and uniqueness of homogeneous degree identifies its degree as m*n. A negative shifted numerator degree forces b=0.

For nonnegative shifted degree, hgraded expresses b in the S-span of images ψ(a) of source homogeneous numerators. Induct on that span. For a generator use twist_fraction_realization on a/f^m and pull back its section; hη and the localRingHom fraction formula compute its image as ψ(a)/(ψ(f))^m. Lift zero and sums additively. Lift scalar multiples by multiplying the lift with the regular chart section given by the degree-zero element algebraMap S B c. Its pointwise value is c/1, so O-linearity of η gives the required scalar multiple. Pointwise equality of fractions proves equality with the original section.
